functions.name: check_tech_availability
functions.description: Return open 2-hour technician arrival windows for supported appliances (refrigeration, dishwasher, laundry, cooking, Bosch, Miele, Gaggenau, Sub-Zero). Do NOT call for unsupported services like pool heaters or water heaters. Zone is OPTIONAL — omit it (preferred default) to search all service areas when the caller says check/go ahead without a zone.

zone.description: Optional. north | central | south. Omit entirely for all zones. Do not pass 'all' or 'any'.

skill.description: Canonical skill: dishwasher, refrigeration, laundry, cooking, bosch, miele, gaggenau, general

appliance_type.description: Same as skill when caller names an appliance (e.g. dishwasher)

functions.name: lookup_job
functions.description: Look up an appointment / job ID when the caller does not know their job ID. Call this with the caller's confirmed account phone number (e.g. +15550108800) to find their job ID, appliance, and scheduled arrival window.

phone.description: Account phone number for caller verification (e.g. +15550108800 or spoken digits).

customer_name.description: Optional caller name on the account to assist lookup.

job_id.description: Optional job ID if verifying a specific appointment.

functions.name: reschedule_parts_install
functions.description: Reschedule a parts installation after validating parts status. Keeps the primary technician from the diagnostic visit when parts are in stock.

functions.name: cancel_appointment
functions.description: Cancel an appointment with verified caller ownership. Requires BOTH job_id AND account phone number (or matching caller ID). Name alone is never sufficient. Enforces 24h fee — if fee_applicable and not yet confirmed, read speak_this, get verbal yes, then call again with the same job_id and confirmed=true. Never invent lookup failures.

job_id.description: Job id (digits ok, e.g. 1088). Required alongside phone for cancellation.

phone.description: Account phone number for caller verification (e.g. +15550108800 or spoken digits). Required to verify ownership.

customer_name.description: Optional caller name to assist lookup.

confirmed.description: True only after caller verbally accepts the fee when fee_applicable was returned.

functions.name: book_appointment
functions.description: Book a technician for an open arrival window for supported appliances. Requires tech_id + window_start from open_windows. Unavailable/stale windows are rejected. Writes a Scheduled job into the CRM cache.

technician.description: Technician display name if tech_id missing (e.g. Lee P.)

window_start.description: arrival_window_start ISO from open_windows (must match an open slot)

phone.description: Caller phone if not available on the call object

model_serial.description: Appliance model/serial if the caller provided one

inbound_webhook.notes: Maps from_number → dynamic_variables for known callers (e.g. Sarah / job 1042).

stack1_contrast.name: check_tech_availability_slow
stack1_contrast.notes: Optional second agent or A/B tool URL to demo uncached pagination latency.
